question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mover><mi>m</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mi>a</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mover><mi>m</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mi>b</mi></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mover><mi>m</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mi>c</mi></msub></math> are <math><mn>3</mn></math> unit vectors such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mover><mi>m</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mi>a</mi></msub><mo>⋅</mo><msub><mover><mi>m</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mi>b</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mover><mi>m</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mi>a</mi></msub><mo>⋅</mo><msub><mover><mi>m</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mi>c</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and the angle between <math><msub><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow></msub></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow></msub><mo>×</mo><msub><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow></msub><mo>-</mo><msub><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow></msub><mo>×</mo><msub><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to

solution.text:
∵m→a⋅m→b=0,m→a⋅m→c=0
⇒m→a⋅m→b-m→c=0⇒m→a is perpendicular to m→b-m→c
Therefore, m→a×m→b-m→c=m→am→b-m→c
=1×1+1-2×1×1×cosπ3
=1
